_doc: Evidence that each pinned engine READS every key our launchers write into its own config file. Checked by scripts/lib/profiles/engine_config_reads.py (gate: scripts/tests/test-engine-config-reads.sh); the tool's docstring has the rules. After an engine pin bump, run: python3 scripts/lib/profiles/engine_config_reads.py verify <engine> --record

setup_only.CONTEXT: Strata's own entrypoint passes it to `strata launch --context` (setup owns it: it sizes the KV and expert cache); strata_config.py only checks it
setup_only.KV: Strata's own entrypoint passes it to `strata launch --kv`; strata_config.py only checks it
setup_only.API_KEY: Strata's own entrypoint passes it to `strata launch` (--api-key-env); strata_config.py only checks its length

reads.reasoning_effort: main(): the server's default effort for requests that name none (logged 'thinking level: ...')
reads.reasoning_budget_tokens: main(): Service.reasoning_budget_tokens, the thinking cap for every request
reads.sampling.temperature: sampling_defaults_from_config(): a default for requests that leave the field out
reads.args:--spec: the engine's own flag: the MTP drafter's verify window
reads.args:--rope-scaling: the engine's own flag: RoPE extension past the trained 262144 (none | linear | yarn; `strata --help`)
reads.args:--rope-scale: the engine's own flag: the linear/yarn extension factor (`strata --help`)
reads.aliases: main(): svc.set_aliases(), other names the model answers to (Strata #297), each listed in /v1/models

reads.reasoning_effort: main(): svc.default_effort (logged 'thinking level when a request names none: ...')
reads.sampling.temperature: sampling_defaults_from_config(): a default for requests that leave the field out
reads.args:--kv: the engine's own flag (its GLM path reads only int8: the launcher refuses q4_0 / k8v4, a value rule this gate doesn't check)
reads.args:--max-context: the engine's own flag: KV/state capacity
reads.model_name: main(): the served name (/v1/models, /props, every answer's model field)
reads.loop_guard: loop_guard_setting(), from main(): svc.loop_guard (serve/loop_guard.py; MAYA_LOOP_GUARD in the environment wins, and no compose forwards it)

reads.reasoning_effort: main(): svc.default_effort (DeepSeek's template: deepseek_effort_kwargs, logged 'thinking level when a request names none: ...')
reads.sampling.temperature: sampling_defaults_from_config(): a default for requests that leave the field out
reads.args:--cpu-threads: maya-ds4's own flag: the CPU lane's threads (the experts VRAM doesn't hold)
reads.model_name: main(): the served name (/v1/models, /props, every answer's model field)
reads.loop_guard: loop_guard_setting(), from main(): svc.loop_guard (serve/loop_guard.py; MAYA_LOOP_GUARD in the environment wins, and no compose forwards it)

reads.reasoning_effort: main(): svc.default_effort (a MiniMax template: effort_name, logged 'thinking level when a request names none: ...'; auto names none, the template's adaptive default)
reads.thinking_budget: main(): svc.think_budget (logged 'thinking budget: N tokens'; MiniMax closes its reasoning with </mm:think>)
reads.sampling.temperature: sampling_defaults_from_config(): a default for requests that leave the field out
reads.args:--max-context: maya-mm3's own flag: K / V capacity (streamed: 32K positions of each layer in VRAM, every one in pinned RAM)
reads.args:--kv-cache: maya-mm3's own flag: the K / V format (int8 its default; the launcher offers bf16 too)
reads.args:--dspark: maya-mm3's own flag: the DSpark drafter in the pack, on or off
reads.args:--cpu-threads: maya-mm3's own flag: the CPU lane's threads (the experts VRAM doesn't hold)
reads.model_name: main(): the served name (/v1/models, /props, every answer's model field)
reads.loop_guard: loop_guard_setting(), from main(): svc.loop_guard (serve/loop_guard.py; MAYA_LOOP_GUARD in the environment wins, and no compose forwards it)
